findings.evidence: Claim 'Best Response RECISTv1 is the strongest univariate predictor of PFS in the DAPPER cohort (smallest BH-adjusted p)' holds in 25% of 48 universes. Single changes that flip it: endpoint=OS; post_baseline=exclude.
findings.question_for_authors: Was the result checked under endpoint=OS; post_baseline=exclude?

findings.evidence: Post-baseline covariates enter the survival models: Best.Response.RECISTv1 (HR 0.18, p=9e-04), Gr1.Gr2.Toxicities (HR 0.5, p=0.0029) and Gr3.Toxicities (HR 2.1, p=0.0011) are measured during/after treatment, so patients must survive long enough to have them (guaranteed-survival / immortal-time bias). The Rmd fits plain coxph with no landmark or time-dependent term.
findings.question_for_authors: Were best response and toxicity analysed with a landmark or time-dependent Cox model?

findings.evidence: [W5] Were blinding and randomisation of samples/animals/patients used and described? -> not_reported. blinding/randomisation of the correlative analyses not described in the available text
